record.body:
## Rationale

The verification-direction brief ordered this phase as skills and contract only: kill claim shrinkage before oracle freeze and before close-time lint. Skills-only leaves fat `criterion` as the brief lead-in. Close-time refusal belongs with later gate hardening and would fight old store rows. Skills plus contract (optional criterion, view requires_payload cleanup) matches the stack decision and keeps the phase reviewable.

## Counter-argument

Close-time lint (option C) would make missing requirement ids a hard gate immediately, so a skill-skipping agent could not close deliver/repair work. The cost is fixture and legacy-store churn in the same phase as the skill rewrite, and it overlaps oracle/evidence work that will add stronger refusals anyway.

payload.choice: skills + contract only (optional criterion, view requires_payload cleanup; no close-time lint)
